## Checklist

- [ ] One product per pull request.
- [ ] The entry uses the format in contributing.md, is one sentence under 280 characters, and sits in alphabetical order.
- [ ] Every claim in the description appears on the linked page, without marketing language.
- [ ] Open source: not archived, a commit on the default branch in the last six months, and 200+ stars or an established company or foundation behind it.
- [ ] Commercial: generally available, with public documentation of the gateway feature.
